title: AddToMealPlanSheet: hierarchical list shell
description: Build the new sheet view structure with NavigationStack, loading state, cancel toolbar, create-new-plan row, per-plan sections, block rows, and inline add-new-section rows.
acceptance_criteria: `AddToMealPlanSheet` exists as a single-screen SwiftUI sheet with title `Add to meal plan` and a leading Cancel button.
The list shows a loading placeholder until plan discovery completes, a create-new-plan row at the top, and one section per discovered plan with block rows plus a final add-new-section row.
The empty state shows only the create-new-plan row when no plans exist.

handoff_summary.completed: Implemented `CookbookApp/MealPlans/AddToMealPlanSheet.swift` with: NavigationStack wrapping a Group, loading state (ProgressView + "Loading meal plans…" text) until `.task` discovery settles, loaded state with a List containing a top "Create new plan…" row (plus.circle.fill), ForEach sections per discovered plan with block-heading rows and an "Add new section…" row, Cancel toolbar button, three alert flows for create-new-plan / add-section / error, and delegation to existing `AddToMealPlanService` methods. xcodegen run and `BUILD SUCCEEDED` confirmed.
handoff_summary.remaining: Downstream beads still needed: wire `RecipeBottomBar` / `RecipeDetailSheet` to present this sheet (rename "Add to menu" → "Add to meal plan", add `onAddToMealPlan` callback, add `showAddToMealPlanSheet` state). Tests for the sheet structure and service.
handoff_summary.risks: The sheet passes `folderURL` as both `recipesFolder` and `folderURL` to `AddToMealPlanService`; this matches the shopping-list pattern but requires the caller to supply the recipes root folder. `addToBlock` / `addNewBlock` service methods do not persist quantity (servings × scale) — only `createNewPlan` does; this is a service-layer gap outside this bead's scope.
handoff_summary.next_action: Wire `RecipeBottomBar` and `RecipeDetailSheet` to present `AddToMealPlanSheet`, rename "Add to menu" → "Add to meal plan", add `onAddToMealPlan` callback.
handoff_summary.conflict_risks: No file-scope conflicts expected. Downstream beads modifying `RecipeBottomBar.swift` and `RecipeDetailSheet.swift` are additive changes to files not touched here.
handoff_summary.design_decisions: Plans are discovered and parsed synchronously in `.task` since `MealPlanFiles.discover` + `MealPlanParser.parse` are fast local file ops. `PlanEntry` is a private struct holding `url` + parsed `MealPlan` to avoid re-parsing on each render. `addSectionTarget` state drives the dynamically-titled "New section in …" alert. The `folderURL` doubles as both `recipesFolder` and plans root, matching the shopping-list sheet convention.
handoff_summary.test_coverage_notes: Tests deferred to tester bead. Sheet structure tests should verify: loading placeholder visible before isLoaded, "Create new plan…" row always present, plan sections with block rows when plans exist, empty state shows only create row, Cancel button present.
handoff_summary.known_limitations: `addToBlock` and `addNewBlock` in `AddToMealPlanService` don't carry quantity (servings × scale); only `createNewPlan` does. Fixing this requires a service-layer change outside this bead.

conflict_risks: No file-scope conflicts expected. Downstream beads modifying `RecipeBottomBar.swift` and `RecipeDetailSheet.swift` are additive changes to files not touched here.
